invariants.rationale: The method always returns HoodieListData.eager(data), which is expected to be non-null.
The method always returns an instance created by HoodieListData.eager, so the type is HoodieListData.
Parallelism is usually a non-negative value defining a degree of parallelization.
HoodieListData.eager(data) should preserve all elements, so the collected result equals input data.
If data is not null, the output HoodieData should preserve the size of the input list.
